body.withheldJunk: Its text is not stored here — your spam verdict filed this message to the Junk folder on your own mail server. It lives on there, and while it does, its headers, this preview and the words search finds it by are kept.

body.withheldExpunged: Its text is no longer stored here — every copy of this message is gone from the folders ohmail reads on your mail server: deleted there, or moved elsewhere by another mail app. Its preview and the words search found it by went with its text. Until you remove the mailbox or delete your account, ohmail keeps who sent it and to whom, its subject and date, the letters it answered, the names of its files, how it was filed and the trackers found in it.
